subject: Re: Renewal — request for pricing relief and SLA addendum
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@veridianhealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz
Date: 2028-07-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal coming up — pricing / SLA concerns

Vanessa,

We appreciate the partnership but we need to raise a couple of items before we can sign the renewal. Over the past quarter we've had three incidents (ticket references included in the attached timeline) that materially impacted two clinical workflows. Given the operational risk, procurement is pushing for either a 30% renewal discount or a one-time credit, plus an SLA addendum (99.95% uptime) for the next year.

Our renewal window closes in nine business days. Can you advise what flexibility Redwood can offer? If we cannot get closer to these asks, we'll have to move some workloads off the platform.

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
Director, Clinical Informatics
Veridian Health

Attachments: Veridian-Support-Timeline.pdf (pdf)
From: vanessa_ortiz
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@veridianhealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-24T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — pricing / SLA concerns

Maria — thanks for the clear summary and for sharing the timeline. Sorry to hear about the impact; I know the team has been working the tickets.

I need to escalate here for concession authority. Short answer: I can't promise 30% off without executive approval, but we can consider a one-time credit and an SLA enhancement on a time-limited basis if we agree to a slightly longer term and a commitment to a usage tier.

I'll open the ask with Deal Desk now and loop in the right folks. Can you share the procurement contact so I can get a signed amendment if we land on terms?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: vanessa_ortiz
To: karthik_iyer, marcus_lin
Cc: marissa_cole
Date: 2028-07-24T10:27:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: Veridian renewal — credit + SLA ask (RDW-4942)

Karthik / Marcus — forwarding a customer renewal escalation (Veridian Health). Key points below and attached.

- ARR at stake: ~$420k ARR (annualized) — renewal term starts 2028-09-01.
- Customer asks: 30% renewal discount OR a one-time operational credit (~$85k), and SLA addendum to 99.95% for 12 months.
- Root cause: three incidents in Q2 impacting clinical pipelines; they provided a support timeline (attached).
- Our risk: if we don’t move quickly, they will begin an RFP in 9 business days.

What I'm asking: 1) Authority to offer a one-time credit and 2) confirm whether we can commit to a temporary SLA bump (12 months) for a subset of workloads (dedicated instances) with monitoring and on-call escalation terms. Customer will sign an amendment and a 12-month commit with a usage floor.

Attachments: Veridian-Support-Timeline.pdf, Veridian-Renewal-Countdown.xlsx

Quick context: Veridian is strategic for our healthcare vertical and a public reference in Q4 if we keep them.

Thanks,
Vanessa

From: karthik_iyer
To: vanessa_ortiz
Cc: marissa_cole, marcus_lin
Date: 2028-07-24T12:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Veridian renewal — credit + SLA ask (RDW-4942)

Vanessa — reviewed attachments and runbook notes from infra. Summary of recommended package for approval: 

1) One-time operational credit: 18% of renewal value (approx $75k) applied at invoice for the first year.
2) SLA addendum: 99.95% for dedicated workloads for 12 months; requires a short technical addendum that scopes the monitored infra and includes remediation time buckets.
3) Term: Offer a 12-month reset (start upon amendment signature) and require a 12-month minimum commit at current seat tier.
4) Conditions: Legal to approve addendum language; require a post-incident joint review and a runbook acceptance by both teams within 60 days.

I think 18% credit + SLA addendum + term reset is defensible vs a 30% discount and limits downside. Approve if Leadership signs off.

Karthik
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole
To: karthik_iyer
Cc: vanessa_ortiz, marcus_lin
Date: 2028-07-24T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Veridian renewal — credit + SLA ask (RDW-4942)

Karthik — I reviewed the summary and the proposed concessions. I approve the package with the following limits and conditions: 

- One-time credit: authorize 18% (~$75k) one-time credit to be applied to Year 1 invoice.
- SLA addendum: approve 99.95% SLA for dedicated workloads for 12 months. Legal must finalize the addendum; product & infra to sign off scope.
- Term: 12-month reset must be signed within the renewal window (9 business days from first email). If Veridian delays signature beyond that window, credit and SLA approval will expire.
- No structural pricing change to list rates — this is a single-instance retention concession.

Marcus, please coordinate legal & infra to produce the addendum draft within 48 hours. Vanessa, you can proceed to offer the package to the customer and capture a signed amendment + purchase order. Keep me on any fleet/usage floor discussions.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@veridianhealth.com>, procurement@veridianhealth.com
Cc: karthik_iyer, marissa_cole, marcus_lin
Date: 2028-07-24T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: retention package for Veridian (RDW-4942)

Hi Maria — thank you for your patience. Following an internal review, Redwood can offer the following retention package if Veridian signs the amendment and PO within the renewal window (9 business days from your original note):

- One-time operational credit equal to 18% of the renewal amount (approx $75k) applied to Year 1 invoice.
- SLA addendum: 99.95% uptime for dedicated workloads for 12 months (scope to be defined in the addendum).
- Term: 12-month term reset that starts on amendment signature; requires a 12-month minimum usage floor at current seat tier.

Conditions: Legal will draft the SLA addendum and share within 48 hours. The credit and SLA commitment expire if the amendment is not signed within the renewal window. We also require a joint post-incident review and acceptance of the runbook within 60 days.

If this package sounds acceptable, please confirm procurement contact and I will route the amendment & PO for signature.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments referenced: Veridian-Support-Timeline.pdf
